exposure: history of child with congenital anomaly
cohort: 664 infants (332 with congenital anomalies and 332 healthy controls) born at Akbar Abadi Hospital between April 2016 and April 2017
finding: Maternal disease, history of child with congenital anomaly, and history of abortion were the most significant risk factors for congenital anomalies.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a higher risk of congenital anomalies compared to natural vaginal delivery (adjusted OR 1.92).
